packageRules.description: Label major updates so the approval workflow can gate on structured metadata instead of PR title text. Renovate applies all labels in one API call, so the workflow treats the renovate label as proof that this label is final.
Automerge non-major updates for development dependencies
Automerge non-major updates for production dependencies with good test coverage

Wait 14 days after a NuGet release before Renovate proposes it. The shipped analyzer runs inside consumers' compilers, so a cooldown gives the ecosystem time to catch a compromised release before it can automerge. Scoped to NuGet so GitHub Actions automerge timing does not change.
Automerge GitHub Actions digest updates. Actions are pinned to commit SHAs, so a digest bump moves the pin within the same version tag.

Transitive pins for the shipped analyzer DLL. These run inside the user's compiler host (.NET 10 SDK minimum, Roslyn 5.0), so major versions must not exceed what that host provides. Roslyn 5.0 depends on 9.0.0, so the caps are System.Collections.Immutable <=9.x and System.Reflection.Metadata <=9.x. See: https://github.com/rjmurillo/moq.analyzers/issues/850

AnalyzerUtilities is bundled in the shipped analyzer. Version 5.6.0+ pulls Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces 10.0.1, which is newer than Roslyn 5.0 (the .NET 10 SDK minimum host) provides. Capped at <5.6.0. See: https://github.com/rjmurillo/moq.analyzers/issues/850
System.Formats.Asn1 is a transitive pin for the shipped analyzer. Manual review required for major updates. See: https://github.com/rjmurillo/moq.analyzers/issues/850

Perfolizer version is dictated by BenchmarkDotNet's exact version constraint [0.6.1]. Updating independently causes NU1608 warnings and potential runtime failures. Disable Renovate for Perfolizer; update manually when BenchmarkDotNet bumps its Perfolizer dependency. See PR #968 for context.
BenchmarkDotNet updates require manual review to verify Perfolizer transitive pin compatibility.
System.CommandLine requires PerfDiff code changes when updated. See: https://github.com/rjmurillo/moq.analyzers/issues/914
